name: Devil's Academy DxD
source:
You're brought back from the dead after a tragic first date. Your saviour, however, is a devil, and now you must serve her and her entire family.

[From [url=https://naitoh.itch.io/devils-academy-dxd]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
第一次約會以悲劇收場後，你被人從死亡中救了回來。然而，你的救命恩人是個惡魔，如今，你必須為她及其整個家族效力。

[摘自[url=https://naitoh.itch.io/devils-academy-dxd]itch.io[/url]]
